panels.title: CrowdSec evidence
panels.description: Contributing events stored in the actual CrowdSec alert. Evidence may be sampled or limited by the scenario. Other requests by the same IP are not automatically contributing events. The fingerprint identifies the exported notification, not a database ID.

options.content:
{{#each (evidenceRows data)}}

{{source_ip}} | {{siteLabel}}

{{startLabel}} to {{stopLabel}}

{{events_count}} contributing events | Observation only

{{method}} {{path}}

HTTP {{status}} | {{site}}

{{time}}
{{/each}}

options.styles: & { overflow-x: hidden; } .dt-row { padding: 0; min-width: 0; } .evidence-summary, .evidence-event { padding: 10px 12px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .evidence-summary { border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); } .evidence-summary h3 { font-size: 16px; line-height: 22px; letter-spacing: 0; margin: 0 0 6px; } .evidence-summary p, .evidence-event p { font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; margin: 3px 0; } .evidence-event { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.3); } .evidence-event strong { font-size: 13px; line-height: 20px; } .evidence-event time { font-size: 12px; opacity: .7; } .evidence-empty { padding: 16px; }

panels.title: Related HTTP requests / newest 100
panels.description: Context only: requests by this exact IP during the detection interval plus 30 seconds on either side. These can include legitimate traffic. CrowdSec's actual contributing events are shown separately above. The fixed window is paused by default.

targets.expr: {security="web",site!="internal-health"} | json | source_ip=${source:doublequote} | __error__="" | line_format `{{.time}} | {{.host}} | {{.method}} {{.path}} | HTTP {{.status}} | {{.source_ip}} | upstream {{.upstream}} / {{.upstream_status}} | {{.duration}}s | {{.bytes}} bytes`
